与校园生活一起成长(Growing up with school life): 一篇关于校园生活的B1记叙文:米娅的经历、感受与成长。
The experience taught Mia more than any book could. Mia is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. The school gate looked quieter than usual that evening. In fact, we have English class at ten.
On Sunday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class. Little by little, things began to change. Mia will take part in a badminton match in October. The lobby became pure one-upmanship.

The school library has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Mia believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. In fact, she is studying sociology at the university this year.

Mia keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Best of all, the old synagogue stands on the hill.
People around Mia often share different ideas about the school gate. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
